# Sample Policy Note

## Data Protection

This sample note is fictitious and is used only for tests. Personal data may be processed only on a documented lawful basis. A data protection impact assessment is required before any processing of personal data at scale.

* Data minimisation;
* Secure storage;
* Access control.

## Budget Transparency

The national budget allocates funds to ministries. Budget documents are published every fiscal year so that citizens can follow public spending.
